title: Gloomweave (Condition)
html:
This article is about content that is inaccessible through normal gameplay. It can still be accessed via in-game exploits or third party tools.

Gloomweave

  • Has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls. Attacking or casting spells that are not Shadowslip ends this condition.

Properties

UID: INVISIBILITY_SHADARKAI_GLOOMWEAVER

 Stack ID: INVISIBILITY

 Stack priority: 1

 More properties:
  • UnavailableInActiveRoll
  • ExcludeFromPortraitRendering

Grants:

 Shadowslip ()
The shadar-kai teleports to an unoccupied space it can see. ( Recharge: Per turn.)

Sources of Gloomweave

  • Invisibility (Shadar-Kai)

Conditions with the same stack ID

Conditions with the stack ID INVISIBILITY, only one of these can be applied at the same time:
Condition Effects
Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
  • Has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls.

Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity attacks, casts another spell, takes an action, or takes damage.

Cloak of Shadows
  • Has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls.
  • Attacking, casting spells, or entering a brightly lit area ends this condition.
Faerie Fire
  • Shedding dim light. Incoming attacks have  Advantage. Cannot be Invisible.
Gloomweave
  • Has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls. Attacking or casting spells that are not Shadowslip ends this condition.
Greater Invisibility
  • Entity has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls. Attack Rolls against it have  Disadvantage
  • When interacting with items, casting spells, or attacking, the entity needs to succeed on a Stealth Check to maintain Invisibility. The Check becomes harder with each successful attempt.
Hide in Plain Sight
  • Affected entity is invisible. It has  Advantage on Attack Rolls. It has a +10 bonus to Stealth Checks.

Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity moves, attacks, casts another spell, takes an action, or takes damage.

Invisible
  • Has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls.

Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity attacks, casts another spell, interacts with an object, becomes wet, takes an action or bonus action, or is damaged.

Invisible
  • Has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls.
  • Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity attacks, casts another spell, takes an action, or takes damage.
One with the Shadows
  • Affected entity is invisible. It has  Advantage on Attack Rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls.

Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity moves, attacks, casts another spell, takes an action, or takes damage.

Umbral Shroud
  • Has  Advantage on  Attack Rolls and imposes  Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls.

Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity attacks, casts another spell, takes an action, or takes damage.
